{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Monthræl''''' was the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] term for personal honor. If a Sakiyan [[Gender/Legends|male]] failed to provide food for his mate and [[Youngling/Legends|children]], his failure was considered a stain against his ''monthræl''.

Similar to ''[[yithræl]]'', the terms referred to different types of honor.
